account_id.description: The account: a leaf account, active. Share capital may take a line (INV-13).

amount.description: The balance in the base currency: a debit balance positive, a credit balance negative.

examples: DBS current account at the books start

origin.description: Only on a director's account: where the balance came from (FR-EQ-01). Required there and refused elsewhere (LEDGER-41).

party_id.description: Only on a director's account (2500, 2120): the director or shareholder whose balance it is, a contact marked one; a balance owed to two founders is two lines. Required there and refused on any other account (FR-EQ-01, B.7; LEDGER-41).
